findings.title: A payment that arrives already refunded at the provider is settled as paid: fulfilment, entitlement and receipt are created, only an alert says the money is gone
findings.evidence: v_charged := v_status in ('paid', 'refunded'); step 8 then runs finance.order_try_commit (stock decremented, entitlement granted, fulfilment 'preparing', receipt queued) and only afterwards finance.attempt_provider_alerts raises external_refund. payment.test.ts:1358 pins exactly this behaviour ('counts as charged'). The ledger's confirmed refunds stay 0, so orders_list.refunded = 0, to_ship counts the line and download.available is true.
findings.impact: Precondition: the webhook/callback could not reach the functions for a while (tunnel down, functions down) and Anas refunded the payment from the Moyasar dashboard before the ledger ever saw it (the runbook's own E02 item 9 drill, or a buyer who asks by phone). When the job later settles it, the order becomes paid, a receipt with the order link goes out, a digital file becomes downloadable and a physical line enters the to-ship list, all for money that is already back with the buyer. One owner_alert email is the only signal.
findings.proposed_fix: In apply_verified_payment step 8, when v_refunded >= v_amount (fully refunded before first settlement) route the payment to review with a new reason (e.g. UNEXPECTED_STATUS or REFUNDED_BEFORE_SETTLE) instead of committing; for 0 < v_refunded < v_amount commit and, in the same transaction, record the provider's total as a provider_dashboard refund via finance.refund_dashboard so the ledger equals the provider immediately. Update the contract section 2 bullet and payment.test.ts:1358.

findings.title: payment_attempt_begin answers HOLD_EXPIRED before it looks for the order's pending invoice, so a reload or the hold-end timer in the last 60 seconds clears the buyer's stored order while the invoice is still payable
findings.evidence: if v_order.hold_expires_at < now() + interval '60 seconds' then return HOLD_EXPIRED ... end if; the select of the active attempt (line 779) comes after. CheckoutForm clears the stored pending order on HOLD_EXPIRED (contract section 10) and PaymentReturn takes its token only from that stored order.
findings.impact: A buyer in the 3-D Secure step during the hold's last minute whose hold view reloaded or whose timer fired gets 'the hold ended' and loses the tab's token; after the redirect the return page verifies without a token (hasToken false), shows no order link and offers no «متابعة الدفع»; the money is still settled correctly and the receipt mail carries the link. UX only, no money effect.
findings.proposed_fix: Move the active-attempt lookup (lines 779-806) above the HOLD_EXPIRED check so a pending attempt is answered with its URL until the attempt itself is closed; keep HOLD_EXPIRED for a new attempt only. Add a payment.test.ts case: pending attempt, hold_expires_at = now()+30s, payment_attempt_begin answers state pending.
findings.prior_overlap: round-04b uncovered: TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS/HOLD_EXPIRED end the view

findings.title: refund-create / refund-record-external on a review payment the configured key cannot see (other mode, or deleted at the provider) answer 503 PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE «تعذّر الوصول إلى بوابة الدفع الآن» instead of 404
findings.evidence: const fetched = await payments.client.fetchPayment(target); if (!fetched.ok) return unavailable()  // unavailable() is 503 PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE for every kind, not_found included; providerPaymentId() returns target.reviewPaymentId with no mode check, so the key's 404 is the only mode gate for a review payment.
findings.impact: The owner is told the gateway is down and to try again shortly, for a payment that will never be found (a sandbox review payment after go-live); nothing is written, so no money effect, but the message misleads and the reconciliation screen keeps the review open with no explanation.
findings.proposed_fix: In refundCreate, refundRecheck and refundRecordExternal map fetched.kind === 'not_found' to 404 NOT_FOUND («لم نجد هذه الدفعة لدى بوابة الدفع») and keep 503 for unavailable/rate_limited; add a unit case in tests/unit/admin-refunds.test.ts with a stub fetchPayment answering not_found.

findings.title: A live webhook that arrives while PAYMENTS_MODE is test (or the reverse) is closed mode_mismatch and parked MODE_CHANGED with no alert and no place in the reconciliation screen
findings.evidence: else if (event.live !== (deps.config.mode === 'live')) await closeEvent(deps, event.id, 'mode_mismatch') — processed_at set, outcome 'mode_mismatch'; finance.event_needs_person (order_operations.sql:173) counts only outcome = 'exhausted'; payment_reconcile_claim parks the attempt as expired/MODE_CHANGED (payment_core.sql:1424) and reconciliation_list lists only UNCERTAIN/UNVERIFIED/PROVIDER_STATUS/EXTERNAL_REFUND reasons.
findings.impact: If the mode is ever switched while invoices of the other mode are pending (a rollback from live to test after an incident), a real payment made in that window is recorded only as a mode_mismatch event row and an expired attempt marked MODE_CHANGED; the owner sees nothing in /admin/orders/reconciliation and gets no email. The runbook describes the parking but gives no query to find it.
findings.proposed_fix: Raise one owner_alert ('mode_mismatch:<eventId>') from the webhook path or from payment_reconcile_claim when it parks a row, and include attempts with last_error = 'MODE_CHANGED' and events with outcome 'mode_mismatch' in reconciliation_list with reason MODE_CHANGED; add the SQL to docs/payments-runbook.md 'Mode checks'.
findings.prior_overlap: R2 uncovered: events of the other mode
